summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the convening of bondholders' meetings for its domestic public debt bonds (2010 and 2013 issuances) to consider a merger by absorption with Parque Solar Portón del Sol S.A.S. The meetings are scheduled for August 18, 2026, and will include a bondholder vote on the proposed merger. This is a routine disclosure of meeting notices and is not itself a special situation event; the merger was previously approved by shareholders. The filing provides no deal terms, price, or premium. What to watch: the outcome of the bondholder vote and any impact on bond terms.
